title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-i98v: lib.rs mod tests left behind after API migration, 27 compile errors
description:
The commit updated tests/vectors.rs for the new OSCORE API (Context::new with id_context, removed load_existing, removed protect_request/protect_response from Context, changed OscoreSeqNum::new to u64, changed derive_key/derive_iv to Option<&[u8]>, changed encode_piv to return Option, changed protect_response to require 6 args with include_piv: bool) but left the internal test module in lib.rs untouched. Result: 27 compile errors when running cargo test -p lichen-oscore.

Affected call sites:
- seqnum.rs:180,183,186,191,192: OscoreSeqNum::new(u32::MAX) should be u64::MAX.into()
- lib.rs:2029,2035,2041,2077: derive_key/derive_iv called with &id_context (Vec ref) instead of Some(&id_context)
- lib.rs:2061,2065: OscoreSeqNum::new(sender_seq as u32) should be as u64
- lib.rs:2079: piv.encode_piv(...) on Option<OscoreSeqNum> needs .unwrap() first
- lib.rs:2287,2434,2442,2738,2820,3266,3271,3302,3306,3312,3316: protect_response called with 5 args, needs 6th bool arg
- lib.rs:2458,2494: Context::load_existing removed from API, needs Context::new + restore_existing pattern
